functions.description: Parse syslog header: timestamp, host, process, pid, and remaining message body
Extract queue-id keyed mail flow fields: client=, message-id=, from=/size/nrcpt, to=/relay/delay/status

conf.regex: /^(?<queue_id>\S+): (?:client=(?<src_host>[^\[]+)\[(?<src_ip>[^\]]+)\]|message-id=<(?<message_id>[^>]+)>|from=<(?<sender>[^>]*)>, size=(?<size>\d+), nrcpt=(?<nrcpt>\d+) \(queue (?<queue_status>[^)]+)\)|to=<(?<recipient>[^>]*)>, relay=(?<relay>[^,]+), delay=(?<delay>[^,]+)(?:, delays=(?<delays>[^,]+))?(?:, dsn=(?<dsn>[^,]+))?, status=(?<status>\S+) \((?<status_detail>.*)\))$/

functions.description: Extract connect/disconnect session events with source host/ip and optional session stats
Extract warning (DNS/SASL auth failure) and NOQUEUE reject events with reason and addresses

conf.regex: /^(?:warning: (?:(?<warn_ip>[\d.:a-fA-F]+): hostname unknown|unknown\[(?<sasl_ip>[^\]]+)\]: SASL (?<auth_method>\S+) authentication failed: (?<auth_reason>.*))|NOQUEUE: reject: RCPT from (?<reject_host>[^\[]+)\[(?<reject_ip>[^\]]+)\]: (?<smtp_code>\d+) (?<enhanced_code>\S+) <(?<reject_recipient>[^>]*)>: (?<reject_reason>[^;]+); from=<(?<reject_sender>[^>]*)> to=<(?<reject_to>[^>]*)> proto=(?<proto>\S+) helo=<(?<helo>[^>]*)>)$/

functions.description: Break out relay host, IP, and port from the SMTP relay field
Normalize src_ip/src_host/user, classify action and severity, set protocol, and drop scratch/duplicate fields

add.name: action
add.value: message.match(/^connect from/) ? 'connect' : message.match(/^disconnect from/) ? 'disconnect' : message.match(/^NOQUEUE: reject/) ? 'reject' : message.match(/SASL LOGIN authentication failed/) ? 'auth_failed' : message.match(/hostname unknown/) ? 'dns_warning' : status ? status : message.match(/client=/) ? 'client' : message.match(/message-id=/) ? 'message_id' : message.match(/from=.*size=/) ? 'queued' : 'other'
